settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure your application preferences.
settings.llmApiDesc: Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Ollama, etc.). API Key is stored locally only.
settings.apiKeyHint: Leave empty for local models like Ollama
settings.modelHint: Examples: gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet, llama3.2, etc.

home.title: Welcome to Corwork
home.subtitle: An Electron desktop app built with Vue 3, Vite, and TypeScript.
home.electronViteDesc: Fast HMR development with electron-vite. Main process hot-reload included.
home.vueTsDesc: Composition API, script setup, and full type safety out of the box.
home.tailwindDesc: Utility-first CSS with dark mode support via custom theme tokens.
home.secureIpcDesc: Context-isolated preload bridge for safe main-renderer communication.

mcp.title: MCP Management
mcp.addFirst: Add your first server to get started.

experts.title: Experts
experts.subtitle: Create custom agents: select MCP tools + preset prompts
experts.whatIsExpertDesc: An expert is a user-defined agent that includes selected MCP tools and preset prompts. After creation, select it in chat to automatically apply its tools and role settings.
experts.noExpertsHint: Create experts to quickly switch between them in chat
experts.modalDescCreate: Custom agent with MCP tools and preset prompts
experts.descPlaceholder: Brief description of this expert's purpose
experts.mcpHint: Check the MCP tools this expert can use
experts.noMcps: No MCP tools. Add some in MCP settings first.
experts.promptPlaceholder: e.g. You are a professional code assistant, skilled in analyzing, refactoring and optimizing code. Respond in the user's language with clear examples.
experts.promptHint: This prompt will be injected as system message to define the expert's role and behavior
experts.noExpertsGoCreate: No experts yet. Go to Experts to create one
